title: Partial obedience still protects something God asked you to surrender.
paragraphs: Partial obedience still protects something God asked you to surrender.

King Saul didn’t deny God.
He adjusted Him.

He kept what looked valuable.
He called it worship.
He justified it with good intentions.
“To obey is better than sacrifice.” – 1 Samuel 15:22

The question isn’t:
“Did I mean well?”

The question is:
“Did I obey fully?”
Does intention matter more than execution?

Is partial obedience still disobedience?
Or does God honor the heart behind it?
